auth.tierTwoPageDescription: This route is accessible only to DecisionMaker and Manager accounts.

empty.title: Select a solution
empty.description: Load a scenario from the left sidebar.

welcome.title: Start with a solution to unlock analysis panels.
welcome.description: Use the Solution Finder to load a scenario, review its metrics, and compare tradeoffs without leaving the map workspace.
welcome.heroTitle: Right-side guidance stays in sync with your workflow.
welcome.heroDescription: When a solution is active, this panel can switch between overview, AOI, and comparison views as the rest of the experience comes online.
welcome.stepsDescription: A lightweight onboarding sequence for first-time users.

choose.title: Choose a solution
choose.description: Open the Solution Finder to load a candidate strategy for the current planning context.

review.title: Review the overview
review.description: Scan headline metrics to understand ecological, climate, and finance signals.

compare.title: Compare options
compare.description: Switch into comparison mode once another solution is available for side-by-side review.

overview.title: Solution overview
overview.description: A compact summary of the current solution and the metrics currently available for review.
overview.noDescription: No description is available for this solution yet.
overview.emptyDescription: Load a scenario from the left sidebar.
overview.loadErrorDescription: Try selecting the solution again, or choose a different one.
overview.insightGains: This scenario secures high-priority biodiversity and ecosystem targets with strong climate co-benefits.
overview.insightCosts: This scenario affects priority implementation areas and should be balanced with socio-economic constraints.

aoi.title: Area of interest detail
aoi.description: Focus the active solution on a selected geography to inspect AOI-specific metrics.
aoi.emptyDescription: Select an AOI to populate this panel with local metrics and context.
aoi.emptyMetricsDescription: AOI metrics appear here once both a solution and an area of interest are available.

comparison.description: Review baseline and candidate solution metrics in one place before making a recommendation.
comparison.emptyDescription: Add a second solution to compare tradeoffs against the current baseline.
comparison.noBaselineDescription: Load an active solution before opening comparison mode.

onboarding.title: Start here to choose the solution you want to inspect.
onboarding.description: Use the left sidebar to launch the Solution Finder, switch between candidates, and drive what appears in the analysis panel.
onboarding.heroDescription: Choose a solution first, then review its metrics and comparisons in the right sidebar.
onboarding.stepsDescription: A simple sequence for first-time users.

choose.title: Open Solution Finder
choose.description: Start a guided search for the best-fit solution for the current planning context.

review.title: Load and switch solutions
review.description: Use this sidebar to control which solution is active before reviewing details.

compare.title: Inspect the analysis
compare.description: Once a solution is active, use the right sidebar to read overview, AOI, and comparison details.

modal.perspectiveDescription: This modal uses the standard shell mode and shares the same close behavior and accessibility features.

finder.title: Find a conservation scenario
finder.description: Select targets and constraints, then run a match against available scenario templates.

comparison.title: Find a candidate solution
comparison.description: Use the same guided workflow to choose the candidate solution for side-by-side comparison.

helpers.constraints: Toggle constraints after selecting at least one target.
helpers.results: Review best matches, then apply one scenario.

locked.results: Run Find matches after Step 1 to unlock results.

empty.title: Run matching to view scenarios
empty.description: Choose at least one target, then click Find matches.

constraints.connectProtectedAreas: Include Corridor Areas Between Protected Areas

results.scenarioJaguarCorridor: Higher emphasis on species corridor continuity near protected area buffers.
results.scenarioAndesWater: Balances cloud-forest protection and water regulation targets in upland basins.
results.scenarioCarbonShield: Prioritizes carbon density while excluding mining pressure and urban edge zones.
